english.title: Obstruct officer / constable exercising power of entry / refuse answer / answer enquiry falsely

On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[obstructed **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..), an officer, in the due exercise of a power conferred on him]_
(B)_[obstructed **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..), an officer, in the due exercise of a power conferred on her]_
(C)_[obstructed **(..SPECIFY CONSTABLE..), a constable, in the due exercise of a power conferred on him]_
(D)_[obstructed **(..SPECIFY CONSTABLE..), a constable, in the due exercise of a power conferred on her]_
(E)_[refused to answer an enquiry, namely **(..SPECIFY ENQUIRY..), authorised]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 28 of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933.
